Woolpert is an award‑winning, global leader in architecture, engineering, and geospatial services. We blend design excellence with cutting‑edge technology to deliver exceptional client value, and as a certified Great Place to Work®, we embrace progress and innovation to create limitless opportunities for career growth. As part of Woolpert, Murphy Geospatial – A Woolpert Company contributes deep geospatial expertise across Europe, supporting complex infrastructure, property, manufacturing, utilities, and natural‑environment projects through world‑class data capture, verification, and governance. Position Overview Murphy Geospatial, a Woolpert company, is seeking a Reality Capture Technician to support a major semiconductor manufacturing project in Dresden. This role is primarily focused on the processing, registration, QA/QC, and management of terrestrial laser scan data captured across a large-scale construction environment. Working as part of our Special Projects team, you will help transform field-captured data into accurate, actionable information that supports construction delivery, quality assurance, and project reporting. This opportunity would suit candidates from a laser scanning, geomatics, surveying, reality capture, digital construction, or BIM background who are looking to develop their expertise on a high-profile international project. What You Will Do Process terrestrial laser scan data captured by project survey teams. Register, align, and quality-check point cloud datasets. Identify and resolve point cloud registration and data quality issues. Prepare structured point cloud deliverables for project stakeholders. Support construction verification and design versus as-built assessments. Produce reports, visual outputs, and technical documentation. Maintain organised project datasets and reporting trackers. Collaborate with surveying, BIM, and construction teams to support project delivery. Technology You'll Work With Leica Cyclone / Cyclone 3DR CloudCompare ClearEdge Verity Autodesk Revit Navisworks Power BI Advanced terrestrial laser scanning technologies What You Will Bring Essential: Experience processing terrestrial laser scan data and point clouds. Experience with point cloud registration and QA/QC workflows. Experience using software such as Leica Cyclone, CloudCompare, Faro Scene, Trimble RealWorks, or similar. Strong attention to detail and commitment to data quality. Fluent English. Full right to work in Germany. Desirable: Experience working with BIM models. Experience in scan-to-model or construction verification workflows. Experience on semiconductor, industrial, pharmaceutical, or data centre projects. Knowledge of Revit, Navisworks, or Power BI. Benefits You Will Love At Murphy Geospatial – A Woolpert Company, you’ll join a collaborative and innovative team where your expertise makes a real impact. Our benefits include: Competitive salary with a comprehensive benefits package aligned to your experience Access to cutting‑edge geospatial technology and industry‑leading tools Flexible working options designed to support work–life balance Enhanced wellbeing support, including employee assistance initiatives Opportunities within a growing, globally connected organisation through our partnership with Woolpert Principal Programme: Earn the opportunity to become an owner of the firm.
